description.text: Training Center has teaching faculty with profound knowledge and rich experiences in the training of the Chinese Language.It offers effective training programs all the year round for those who wish to improve their Chinese Language proficiency. Students can choose classes at different levels according to their own levels. Class Level Class Name Schedule Objective Elementary Chinese I Elementary Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in September or February/March every year. For students knowing nothing about Chinese language, could learn more than 1000 words, make easy daily conversations with Chinese people and pass HSK Basic (Standard exam for testing Chinese language level) by the end of the semester. Elementary Reading Elementary Spoken Chinese Elementary Listening Chinese Practice Elementary Chinese II Elementary Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in February/March or September every year. For students who already have more than 1000 words or have learned Chinese for more than 400 class hours, they can learn more than 2000 words, have more complete daily conversations with Chinese people, and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester. Elementary Reading Elementary Spokem Chinese Elementary Listening Sciences in Chinese Chinese Practice

duration.text: The Elementary Chinese Language and Culture Program at Wuhan University of Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be age of 16 or above 2.High school graduate or equivalent or above
